text:
[4. CONSENT AGENDA ITEMS]
[BFC 26-062] - Report regarding the reimbursement agreement between the
  Consolidated Fire Protection District of Los Angeles County and the City of Los Angeles
  for aircraft resources.
  Recommendation: That the Board approve the report and adopt the recommendations
  therein.
summary: The fire board approves a reimbursement agreement between the county's Consolidated Fire Protection District and the city covering aircraft resources.
